Hi Todd,

Your order Shop···· is paid and has not shipped yet. It holds the Magic Miner 40T, the Miner Duster and the Power Kit, going to (address hidden).

The date on it was October 31. The D. is on the shelf at our Chattanooga warehouse, but the 40T and the Power Kit are still waiting on the incoming batch, so the box has not gone out. I am sorry about that, and I do not want to give you a date I cannot stand behind, so I have asked the team to confirm the new one. They pick this up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes straight to your email.

In the meantime you can watch that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . It can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses.

As soon as it is labelled you get the tracking by email automatically.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
